highlights.text_zh: 马斯克称 Robotaxi 每周可运行 168 小时。

highlights.excerpt: Thank you @JensenHuang for 33 years of bold leadership. You built a small startup into America’s most valuable company, with relentless improvement. Your grit and perseverance should always be remembered. Your personal generosity with time and advice to founders like me has secured a bright future for America and AI.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 感谢 @JensenHuang 33 年来的果敢领导。你把一家小创业公司做成了美国最有价值的公司，并不断改进。你的毅力与坚持应当被铭记。你对像我这样的创始人慷慨付出时间与建议，为美国和 AI 赢得了光明的未来。
highlights.name: Aravind Srinivas
highlights.text_zh: Perplexity CEO 感谢黄仁勋 33 年领导，把小公司做成美国市值最高的企业。

highlights.excerpt: You’d think we’d have learned from Steve Jobs and Travis Kalanick that one does not just simply replace the founder…
highlights.excerpt_zh: 按理说，我们该从 Steve Jobs 和 Travis Kalanick 那里学到：创始人不是能随随便便换掉的……
highlights.name: Naval
highlights.text_zh: Naval 说，乔布斯和卡兰尼克已经说明：创始人不是能随便换掉的。

highlights.excerpt: If that Spy’s goal was to destabilize one of the most successful American companies, they achieved their goal. Ousting Jensen feels rushed and not right.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 如果那个 Spy 的目标是动摇美国最成功的公司之一，那他们已经达到目的。赶走黄仁勋让人觉得仓促，也不对。
highlights.name: Peter Steinberger
highlights.text_zh: Peter Steinberger 认为赶走黄仁勋过于仓促，若目的是动摇这家成功公司则已经达成。

推出 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，这是一款非常强、也非常快的模型，旨在把 Gemini 4 带给所有人！

highlights.excerpt:
This whole thing sucks, and I wish none of it had happened. It’s a really sad day!

But I want to make one thing clear: we’ll keep fighting for open-source AI, harder than ever. This is too important to slow down now. Let’s go!
highlights.excerpt_zh:
整件事糟透了，我希望它从来没有发生过。这真是悲伤的一天！

但我想说清楚一点：我们会继续为开源 AI 奋斗，而且会比以往更努力。这件事太重要了，现在不能放慢。走起！
highlights.name: clem 🤗
highlights.text_zh: Hugging Face CEO 称今天很难过，但会更努力推动开源 AI。
